obfuscation_indicators: cannot assure estimates will be accurate
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively detailed and quantified, but emphasizes substantial estimation uncertainty under percentage-of-completion accounting and the possibility of revenue, profit, and cash-flow adjustments. A-10 program reductions, amended debt covenants, higher borrowing costs, and reliance on potential customer reimbursements indicate meaningful operating and liquidity risk, partly offset by stated covenant compliance and expected resource sufficiency.
